description:
This one-bedroom, one-bathroom furnished apartment is available to let within the sought-after Horizon development in central Bristol, offering modern city living in a convenient location. The property benefits from a balcony with views towards the communal gardens, which residents can also enjoy.

Situated in Bristol's BS1 area, the property is ideally placed for access to the Harbourside, Cabot Circus and the city centre, all of which offer a wide range of shops, cafés, bars and restaurants. Brandon Hill Park and Castle Park are both within easy reach, providing attractive green spaces for walking and leisure.

The development benefits from excellent transport links. Bristol Temple Meads station is approximately a 15-minute walk, or a short bus journey away, providing regular services to London Paddington in around 1 hour 40 minutes, as well as connections to Cardiff, Bath, Exeter and destinations across the South West and Midlands. Numerous bus routes also serve the area, offering convenient access to Clifton, Redland, Southville and other parts of the city.
